capabilities: render "-#" lines as compact muted headings in all view modes
toggle the "-#" token on single or multiple selected lines via a smart command
support negative headings inside list items
escape "-#" with a backslash to render it as literal text
extras: Not yet approved for the Obsidian community plugin repository; installation from source is described. Known rendering issue with negative headings inside deeply nested list items in Reader Mode.
problem: Obsidian has no heading level lighter than H6, so users lack a visually low-weight subheading for organizing content.
summary: Markdown renderer that displays Discord-style "-#" lines as compact, muted subheadings in Reading View, Live Preview, and Source mode.
